Technological Awareness: Students will create an index page for a website.

objectives: Plan a website based on goals, target audience and budget in a team environment.
Prepare and manage website content.
Apply web usability, accessibility and information architecture standards to website content, navigation and design.
Use and validate standards-based code.
Create optimized website content and code.
Apply design principles to website design.
Test website for accessibility, usability and server performance.
Launch website and conduct final checks.
Set up a maintenance management schedule.
Use qualitative and quantitative data to improve website performance.
Analyze and establish advertizing strategies.
